title: On the irrationality measure of log 3
relevant_concepts: linear independence measure of 1, log 2, log 3
notes: Journal of Number Theory 142 (2014) 264-273. Effective |a + b log 2 + c log 3| ≥ H^{-4.1163051-ε} with H = max(|b|,|c|), hence μ(log 3) ≤ 5.1163051. Improves Rhin 8.616 and Salikhov 5.125. The Juggler padic-coupling branch records that this two-logarithm measure does not produce a 2-adic/3-adic coupling quantity on 3^o − 2^L. docs/problems/juggler_cycle_padic_coupling.md, docs/problems/juggler_cycle_gap_baker.md.
